works.title: Rose from Riel's Partner, Kyle
works.provenance: Received in Starbucks Antlers on November 2026 with a note congratulating me on my healing journey.
works.commentary: Riel and Kyle were willing distractions during the earlier weeks of my breakup with Marc. They kidnapped me to be their third wheel in Tagaytay date, and I am very thankful of them.
